mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, disabled, virtual_warehouse_id, warehouse_id
mapper.select:
select warehouseId,warehouseName,disabled from (select w.id warehouseId,w.name warehouseName,w.disabled from virtual_warehouse_relation vwr inner join warehouse w on vwr.warehouse_id=w.id and w.is_deleted=false and w.disabled=false where vwr.is_deleted=false and vwr.disabled=false
and ( (w.id = #{params.searchKeyword}) or w.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and vwr.virtual_warehouse_id = #{params.virtualWarehouseId}
group by w.id order by
case when w.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when w.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when w.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , w.name,
w.id) warehouse

select virtualWarehouseId,virtualWarehouseName,disabled from (select vw.id virtualWarehouseId,vw.name virtualWarehouseName,vw.disabled from virtual_warehouse_relation vwr inner join virtual_warehouse vw on vwr.virtual_warehouse_id=vw.id and vw.is_deleted=false and vw.disabled=false where vwr.is_deleted=false and vwr.disabled=false
and ( (vw.id = #{params.searchKeyword}) or vw.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and vwr.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId}
group by vw.id order by
case when vw.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , vw.name,
vw.id) virtualWarehouse
